# ts-diag and Diagnostic Workflows

> Standardized MongoDB diagnostic triage workflow utilizing ts-diag scripts to collect cluster topology, hardware utilization, system logs, and FTDC archives into structured diagnostic bundles.

## Documentation
- [Full Documentation](llms-full.txt): Comprehensive operational and architectural guide
- [Small Digest](llms-small.txt): Compact operational cheat sheet
- [Atomic Facts](llms-facts.txt): Key facts, limits, and configuration values
- [Vocabulary](llms-vocabulary.txt): Domain terminology and concepts
- [Concept Graph](concept-graph.json): Directed relationship graph
